body:
PR #2656 (BUG-2135) has been updated with round 1 requested changes and marked ready for review.

Head SHA: cdc443a02b156cc667f9af1e69c830aab154a7a5

Changes addressed:
1. Pre-start sccache server with stable TMPDIR (/tmp) when no server is running in dev_build.rs and check-ci-gates.py.
2. Updated restart hint command to: sccache --stop-server; TMPDIR=/tmp sccache --start-server
3. Wired tests/test_bug_2135_sccache_tmpdir.py into .github/workflows/ci.yml and scripts/ci-gate-tiers.toml (fast tier), refactored into unittest.TestCase fixtures.
4. Respected opt-out when RUSTC_WRAPPER is empty or non-sccache, dropped ensure_sccache_server from dev_build cargo invocation, dropped hardcoded path, and silenced start-server stdout/stderr.
Passed make check-ci-fast locally.
subject: PR #2656 (BUG-2135) ready for review
